info.name: Partnerize Brands Attribution Brand Conversions API

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date for data to be included in the report

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date for data to be included in the report

params.name: text_date
params.description: Restricts the results to one of the following - this hour, last hour, today, yesterday, this week, last week, last X days, this month, last month, this year, last year.

params.name: currency[]
params.description: Filter the results by the specified currency

params.name: date_type
params.description: This parameter to run the report for conversions that have been updated. When you specify `last_modified` or `approved_at` the response will only include conversions that were last modified or approved at in a date within the report date range.

params.name: multipivot[{pivot}][]
params.description: Add a secondary pivot filter. You need to specify the pivot parameter name and the value to filter by. E.g. multipivot[publisher][]=111111l29. Supported values are: `publisher`, `product`, `advertiser_reference`.

params.name: statuses[]
params.description: Filter by statuses. Available values - approved, pending, rejected

params.name: include_payment_info
params.description:
Include payment information. Omit parameter or false to exclude, which is the default. Fields included are:
+ payment_status
+ invoice_create_date
+ invoice_paid_date

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the results by a given amount. Defaults to 0.

items.docs: Return a mix of aggregated and basket/item level conversion data for a brand.
